issues.description: The template's Farm.singFarmSongVerse method is declared without a parameter (private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)) while the problem statement UML and the solution implementation define singFarmSongVerse to accept an Animal parameter. This mismatch is structural: students following the specification will implement singFarmSong() to call singFarmSongVerse(animal) and encounter a signature/compile mismatch in the template, causing confusion or compilation errors.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template method signature to match the specification and solution: declare singFarmSongVerse to accept an Animal parameter (private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)) and update its body to use that parameter. Ensure singFarmSong() iterates animals and calls singFarmSongVerse(animal).
